title: Crestline Companion Hawaii Surcharge Retention: Advance-Planning Waiver Training Notes
content:
**What does the advance-planning waiver reward?** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a companion booking made well ahead of travel reduces the surcharge retention kept from its Hawaii surcharge refund.

**How is "ahead" measured?** In calendar days from the entry date of the most recent companion booking on the certificate or pass to its travel date, the entry date excluded and the travel date included.

**What does each lead time give?**

| Calendar days from booking entry date to travel date | Advance-planning waiver of the surcharge retention |
|---|---|
| 45 or more | 20 percent |
| 21 to fewer than 45 | 10 percent |
| fewer than 21 | none |

**Where do the boundaries fall?** 45 days gives 20 percent and 44 days gives 10 percent; 21 days gives 10 percent and 20 days gives none.

**Hypothetical example.** A booking entered on 1 March for travel on 15 April counts 45 days (2 March to 15 April), giving 20 percent. Entered on 2 March for the same travel date, it counts 44 days, giving 10 percent.
